scope: Independent synthetic low-angle diagnostic only; not a production airframe or a migration of old polars.
axes: Flow frame: x along aircraft air-relative velocity (drag -x), y right, z down; datum fixed at center leading edge, trailing edge at negative x.

section_2d.provenance: Explicit synthetic linear section, not measured and not inferred from existing tables.

load_transfer: Area-weighted equivalent cell wrenches, including explicit couples to preserve the strip resultant at its declared aerodynamic center. Not a chordwise pressure or local structural-stress prediction.
